name: AllMenus

sources.title: Allmenus FAQ — free listing/maintenance for restaurants; updates via Restaurant Center; menus accepted by email/fax/mail/website

conditions: Listing is free ('Absolutely nothing' per FAQ) but the site is a US restaurant menu guide — only restaurants with a menu qualify; part of the Grubhub portfolio since 2011
requirements: A real US restaurant with a menu — not applicable to SaaS/software products
Menus accepted via email, fax, mail, or an online source (restaurant website)
Updates/corrections go through the Restaurant Center request flow
preparation: Current menu (file or URL on the restaurant website)
Online menu URL if available — Allmenus can pull from it
workflow: Go to the Allmenus Restaurant Center (linked from the FAQ — the batch's /for_restaurants/ URL 404'd)
Submit the restaurant + menu via the Restaurant Center update/add request, or send the menu by email/fax/mail per the FAQ
Alternatively, listings can be pushed via listing-sync providers (e.g., Yext lists Allmenus as a publisher)
Wait for Allmenus to publish/maintain the listing at no cost
watchFor: Vertical mismatch: restaurants only — a SaaS launch cannot use this legitimately
The batch submission URL /for_restaurants/ 404'd; the live route is the Restaurant Center linked from /faq/
Homepage returned compressed/binary content to the fetcher — expect bot protection
Distribution is managed (Allmenus aggregates from data providers too) — turnaround unknown
countsAsLive: The restaurant's public page exists on allmenus.com with its menu and details
unknowns: Exact Restaurant Center submission form fields and turnaround
Whether a direct 'add new restaurant' form still exists vs update-only requests
